Title: What a scan reads
Pointer: 1090, 139

Using the folder's own ignore files, the scan will read **15,593 files** and leave out **1,651**. That is the total of 17,244 before any ignore rules were applied.

I clicked "Use" to take in the 25 `.gitignore` and 15 `.tfignore` files the folder already has, and nothing else. The 1,651 excluded files come from the folder's own ignore files, mostly `.dll` (666), `.pdb` (222) and `.xml` (208) matches across 43 folders. I didn't click "Scan", so this is the page's estimate, not a completed scan.
